*Feel-good funky blues-rock, piano boogie, cheeky brass, handclaps, swaggering bass, big singalong chorus.*

## Verse 1

Found ten dollars in my old blue jeans,
Coffee was hot and the lights stayed green.
Got the last good parking space sitting right there,
Boss said, “Nice work,” nearly fell off my chair.

## Pre-Chorus

Some days life gives you splinters and scars,
Today it’s handing out cigars.

## Chorus

**Winner, winner, chicken dinner!**
Some days you lose, some days you’re a winner,
Raise your glass, let the good times begin,
You don’t need the jackpot
To call it a win!
Life ain’t perfect, but it’s getting better,
Winner, winner, chicken dinner!

[Fun Solo Battle with clapping 👏🥰]

[Verse 2]
Phone hit one percent, charger appeared,
Every little crisis somehow disappeared.

My team came back with a minute to play,
The dog actually listened to something I say,

And the shirt I bought that was slightly too tight,
Well, would you look at that…
It fits me tonight!

[Pre-Chorus]
Some days life gives you lemons so sour,
But I leave work early, in half an hour.

[Chorus]
Winner, winner, chicken dinner!
Some days you lose, some days you’re a winner,
Raise your glass, let the good times begin,
You don’t need the jackpot
To call it a win!
Life ain’t perfect, but it’s getting better,
Winner, winner, chicken dinner!

[Bridge - half-time, bluesy piano]
Maybe winning isn’t coming first,
Maybe losing isn’t always worst,
Maybe fortune’s just a state of mind,
Seeing what you’ve got
Instead of what you couldn’t find.

So if you made it home,
And somebody’s there,
There’s food on the table,
And a laugh you can share…

Buddy, you’re richer
Than you think you’ve been.

[Stop]

That sounds like a win.

[Big Final Chorus]
WINNER, WINNER, CHICKEN DINNER!
Turn it up loud, let the whole room shimmer,
Yesterday lost, but today came through,
Sometimes winning’s just enjoying the view.

Raise your glass to the shape that you’re in,
You don’t need the jackpot…

[Band stops]

To call it a win!
